column2: Work on the tent ground reportedly began about four days after the killing, including on a Sunday. Whether landscaping and paving altered trace evidence is the open question — anything removed can never be re-examined.

TPUSA has publicly used synthetic Kirk audio, which citizen accounts say raises the bar for any clip claiming to be his voice. Paired with claims that tech partners tracked 270,000-plus phones around the stadium memorial. An argument about evidence standards, not a finding that anything was faked.

AmericaFest 2024 ran December 19–24, and Tucker Carlson closed the first night reportedly discussing Epstein as a possible foreign-intelligence blackmail operation. Nine months before Kirk was killed. It dates the moment the AmFest main stage was already open to that subject.
The first AmericaFest without Charlie Kirk — and the conference whose flyer he released sixteen days before he died. He programmed the public face of it; someone else ran it. Roughly 30,000 attended.

Every AmericaFest and TPUSA summit the case touches, 2023 through 2026, in one column. It is also the fastest way to see why so much commentary is five months off: the summer Tampa summit keeps getting called "AmFest."

TPUSA released the December AmFest flyer on August 25, 2025 — sixteen days before Kirk was killed, three weeks after the donor weekend where he was allegedly told to drop Tucker Carlson. Carlson is on it, prominently. The date is documentary; the placement reading is commentary.

At AmFest 2025 Bannon reportedly argued that "Greater Israel" and "Israel First" — not deplatforming — are the central fight on the right. War Room clips also credit Kirk with working to block an Iran land war. Bannon's political claims, not court findings.

December 19, 2025: Bannon declares "We are at war" on the first AmFest stage without Kirk and elevates him in maximal historic terms. Compare it with his 2024 close, "Victory or Death!" — the continuity may be higher than the rupture.

The method behind the whole section: a conference program is a published document, so who is allowed on stage can be checked year over year. It is the one motive-adjacent claim in this case that is falsifiable. Bookings prove messaging direction, never authorship of a shooting.

The claim that pro-Israel donors wanted Candace Owens kept off TPUSA's flagship stage — and that Kirk's September 9 move to invite her read as defiance. Graded item by item: which anchors are documents and which are recycled memes.

On September 9, 2025 — the day before he was killed — Kirk reportedly texted that he would invite Candace Owens to speak at AmFest. The same evening carries the all-caps kill-me message. One short text, and the reason authentication matters more here than anywhere.

Kirk put Dave Smith on a TPUSA main stage opposite Josh Hammer on July 13, 2025, on the U.S., Israel, Epstein and Mossad. Both lanes claimed victory; donors were reportedly furious. The booking Kirk controlled is the fact — the rest is discourse.
A search log, not a biography. A dedicated research query for "Debra Carlson" returned no public hits at harvest, and the page says so rather than inventing a role. Negative results are results.

The lineup-control slice of the donor fight: reported texts about losing a major donor for refusing to cancel Tucker Carlson, and the windows where pressure was allegedly applied. Every named donor's denial is on the page. Lawful leverage is not assassination.

Megyn Kelly says she captured Kirk backstage telling Tucker Carlson to "go max" before the July 2025 TPUSA stage. Citizen investigators read it as permission to hit Israel and Epstein material without self-censoring for donors. A pep talk is not a proof chain.

July 20, 2025 — exactly two months before September 10 — is the week researchers treat as the anchor, because an Egyptian tail number and a not-yet-announced police commissioner drew search interest before either was news. The AmFest half of the correlation is the weakest link.

Kelly sits at three junctions: she shared TPUSA stages with Kirk, she is the named source for the GO MAX capture, and on August 6, 2025 Kirk went on her show and described donor pressure in his own words.

Viral September 2025 posts claimed Kirk had invited Marjorie Taylor Greene to debate AIPAC at AmFest after she called for AIPAC to register under FARA. No primary invite, email or Greene transcript is in the file — which is why the page grades it weaker than the flyer.

Six motive theories that run through AmFest, each with the accounts asserting it and the better documentary anchor underneath. Deliberately not a conclusion. Where a post jumps from booking politics to a named murderer, the jump is labelled unproven.

At AmericaFest 2025 TPUSA reportedly built a replica of the "Prove Me Wrong" tent and attendees queued for selfies. Tribute, trauma reenactment, or narrative infrastructure depending on who you ask. Keep it separate from what happened to the actual ground at UVU.

The work order for this section: contracts, transcripts, guest lists and clip-boost logs that would settle the conference-control claims without assuming a plot first. Eighteen numbered asks and a copy-paste field checklist.

The hub for every AmFest claim — the booking record Kirk controlled, the pressure record that ran through August 2025, and the first conference held without him. A conference program is announced and printed, which makes it the most falsifiable part of the motive discussion.

TPUSA's Student Action Summit, Tampa, July 11–13, 2025 — the event constantly mislabelled "AmFest in Florida." A debate on Israel, Epstein and Mossad was staged at Kirk's own conference, fifty-eight days before he was killed. The strongest booking evidence in the case.

At AmFest 2025 Ben Shapiro reportedly named Tucker Carlson and Megyn Kelly for not denouncing Candace Owens's theories, calling the silence cowardice. Media-industry combat on Kirk's stage — and evidence the discipline function stayed live after he died.

Who spoke, by year, with the source for each lineup. No contract trail is public and no booking-department record of vetoes has ever been released — enough to compare years, not enough to prove why any single name moved.

On the first AmFest stage without Kirk, Carlson reportedly told the audience that taking AIPAC money is America-last and that criticizing AIPAC is not antisemitism. Continuity, or a single allowed safety valve — both readings circulate. The video is the datum.

The load-bearing AmFest claim: that Kirk was pressed at an August 2025 donor weekend to rescind Tucker Carlson's invitation, refused, and lost a major donor. Every principal denies the confrontation on the record. The flyer three weeks later still shows Carlson.

What the conference actually is — a multi-day Phoenix event drawing tens of thousands, and simultaneously a recruiting funnel, a content studio, a donor ritual and a discipline mechanism. Read it before the pages about invitations, flyers and a replica tent.

Speaker fights are loud; operational control is quieter and often more decisive — who signs a rider, kills a camera angle, schedules night crew. Mosaic Pro Events produced AmericaFest, the summits and the stadium memorial. Vendors execute scopes of work.

The raw X harvest on AmFest speaker fights, preserved with post IDs and engagement figures at harvest. It documents the dominant folk theory, then shows where the flyer and the December lineup contradict it.

The full Kirk–Owens text record as Owens has published it, including the "revolution" message and the September 9 AmFest line. Owens is both a friend with alleged texts and the story's most active investigator; the page keeps those roles apart.

A dense cluster of alleged statements about danger, donor pressure and breaking with pro-Israel politics, organised by source tier and given permanent KM claim numbers. Same ID, same link, everywhere on the site.

The all-caps September 9 message, given its own permanent claim number so the same quote is not double-counted across the site. Alleged — and who received it has never been established in a public filing.

The allegation that labelling foreign-nexus questions "antisemitism" or "blood libel" worked as rhetorical closure — not removing the question, just making it radioactive to ask. The page notes the dynamic cuts both ways.

Reported allegations that the counterterrorism review into a possible foreign role was shut down before its leads were run down — attributed to New York Times and Daily Mail reporting and to Kent's own March 2026 interviews.

Civil suits between living people over what has been said about September 10 — including a security chief suing the case's most prominent commentator. The clearest measure of what naming a name actually costs.

Contractor Dan Merrell says on camera he was called to pave the courtyard where Kirk was killed, and that coordinators cited orders requiring the work be done by Monday. A reported account; the page does not assert evidence was destroyed.

Four proposed federal laws built to pull calendars, contracts, travel records and unredacted communications into daylight — including the full 90-day pre-death message record. The answer to every "no document is public" line in this section.

The densest pre-assassination search cluster, roughly seven weeks out. The reasoning that makes it hard to wave off: a six-character Egyptian tail number has essentially no organic search demand anywhere. Trends shows interest, never identity.

The podcast that has driven more tips in this case than any other single show — Egyptian aircraft, UVU hotel occupants, TPUSA governance. Read it alongside the pages that grade which of those tips held up.
The libertarian commentator Kirk put on a TPUSA main stage against Josh Hammer, and his own coverage of the case since. Tracked separately from the booking fight that made him a flashpoint.

The show that went live within minutes of the shooting and has stayed on the case since — and the source of the backstage GO MAX capture. A former litigator's read on forensics and courtroom strategy.
War Room has covered the case continuously since September 2025, and Bannon himself is an AmFest fixture across 2023–2025. His brand is permanent emergency; read the coverage with that in mind.
Kirk reportedly went to the White House on June 18, 2025 specifically to argue against regime change in Iran. This page collects what he said and did; whether it raised his risk is argued separately.

The motive logic stated plainly: not that Iran acted, but that Kirk's opposition to a U.S.–Iran war placed him against that war's most powerful advocates. Reasoning about incentive, not proof of a crime.
The claim that after Kirk died, the organization and the show carrying his name shifted toward the pro-war posture he had reportedly been breaking from — the mirror image of his final positions.

Carlson appeared on Kirk's show less than 24 hours before UVU, and later said on camera that he believes the killing was about Kirk's evolving Israel views rather than the culture-war fights. His reported belief, not a court finding.

Reported outreach before September 10 — an invitation to Israel that Kirk reportedly declined, and a funding claim with no released transcript — set against the public statements afterward. Contact is confirmed; the terms are not.

The alleged remarks in which Kirk voiced fear that moving against Israel could get him killed, catalogued as numbered KM claims so the same quote is not counted twice. Every one is alleged and sourced to secondhand posts.

The motive theory stated plainly: whoever controls the flagship conference stage steers what a national youth movement is allowed to hear about Israel and war. A coherent motive story, and explicitly not proof of authorship.

Kirk's short-form clip factory fed millions of under-30 viewers, and the theory holds that editorial control over it was itself worth taking. Succession and platform policy are the ordinary explanations.

Why proponents argue Israel-aligned actors carried the strongest reported motive: few Americans could move MAGA and Christian-conservative opinion the way Kirk could. Motive is a reason someone might want an outcome, never evidence of involvement.

Owens released material from a nine-person WhatsApp chat dated September 8, 2025, including a line about losing a $2 million donor over not cancelling Tucker Carlson. Outlets split between aggregating her claims and fact-checking them.

Private messages attributed to Kirk reached the public through compilations and podcast segments, never through authenticated court exhibits. Source chain, recipients and context are all still open — and every AmFest text claim rests on this problem.
Strange event #7 in the master file: a replacement figure reportedly went on Fox News identifying himself as continuing leadership within one to four hours of Kirk's death, during an active manhunt.

A paralegal who says she handles defense procurements walked through a USASpending contract for miniaturized anti-personnel charges. Its delivery deadline is August 25, 2025 — the same day the AmFest flyer dropped.

Motive frameworks arguing the killing required capabilities beyond a lone gunman — foreign-policy stakes, aircraft movements, and a blocked counterterrorism probe. No court has attributed the killing to any intelligence service.

Co-founder of The Daily Wire and one of the most prominent pro-Israel voices in American media — a recurring AmFest keynote across years, including the December 2025 stage. Not accused of involvement in Kirk's death.

The pro-Israel columnist who took the other side of the July 2025 debate Kirk approved, and whose name recurs in Hamptons commentary. He is accused of nothing here, and attendance itself remains alleged.

The one name that runs through every AmFest in this file: the 2024 Epstein close, the July 2025 Tampa stage, the August flyer, and the December AIPAC remarks. He has said publicly he believes Kirk was murdered over his evolving Israel views.
An Egyptian-registered Falcon 7X reportedly parked near Provo from September 4 until the morning of September 10, leaving the country in the hours around the killing. Candace Owens's "yellow plane."

Fourteen areas where observers and disaffiliated chapters say the organization took positions contradicting Kirk's own stated ones after September 10 — Massie, Iran, Israel donors, and his personal accounts among them.

How fast continuity leadership was announced — a replacement figure reportedly on Fox News within one to four hours, during an active manhunt. Defenders cite the need to reassure staff, donors and chapters.

One narrow question, answered narrowly: did the organization Kirk built move from his restraint on Iran toward supporting air strikes? Nobody is quoted calling for ground troops, and the page says so.

The dated chronology of where Erika Kirk was reported to be and what she said, from spring 2025 through the 2026 hearings. Her own statements and denials sit beside every disputed item. She has never been charged with anything.

The ceremonial and institutional aftermath — from the moment of notification through the memorial service, the succession announcement, the posthumous honors and the resignations. The criminal-investigation track runs on a separate timeline.

Five weeks of chronology built around one reported early-August weekend Kirk is said to have afterwards called an "intervention." Both accounts run side by side, denials included in full. It is where the AmFest invitation dispute actually happened.
The last full day Kirk was alive, tracked hour by hour in Mountain time, centred on a contentious private meeting with pro-Israel advocates and the alleged messages that came out of it.

July through September 10, 2025, with every entry labelled confirmed, evidenced, disputed or unverified. The grading is the point — it is what stops the summer from collapsing into one undifferentiated claim.
The date hub for July 20, 2025, where two claims converge: SU-BTT's alleged first U.S. landing at a Nebraska Army base, and a claimed foreign-leaders military meeting on U.S. soil.

The NCTC director says his center's foreign-nexus review was stopped early — "stop what you're doing now because we have a suspect." He also says people posted online that Kirk would die that day. On the record, on video.

The campus section — what happened at Utah Valley University on September 10, 2025, with the shot placed at about 12:23 PM Mountain time and a likelihood chart built from public claims rather than any government finding.
Redacted GRAMA records from September 9, 2025 show internal UVU communications about two men who asked to speak with police about "a plan." The night before.

State of Utah v. Tyler Robinson, case 251403576, is where the government's narrative meets adversarial testing — every court date, the day-by-day preliminary hearing transcripts, and the inconclusive ATF ballistics.

Everyone public commentary places at the summer 2025 donor weekend, in one table, each marked with what is claim and what is verified. No court record in this repository proves the meeting occurred or who attended.

The routing memo for every suppression thread in this case — platform, court, witness and search — each one attributed rather than asserted. Censorship does not prove a cover-up by itself; it explains the gaps in what survived.

December 5, 2025: Brussels issued the first Digital Services Act fine ever, €120 million against the platform where nearly all citizen investigation of September 10 actually lives. The three findings were transparency failures, not moderation — which is exactly what the two sides argue about.

Two accounts reported on the same August 2026 day that a poll asking whether people still believe the initial rifle account would not publish as a poll. No platform log, no error code, no control test — and unusually easy for anyone to check.

The channel behind this investigation reports that recommended and search traffic sit at or near zero, so videos reach subscribers and almost nobody else. Extremely common for small channels — which is why the page keeps the ordinary explanation on the table.

Monetisation reportedly removed, replies folded, and a paid campaign that delivered roughly fifty views against a represented hundred thousand. Self-reported analytics are weak evidence; they are also the only evidence a platform ever leaves a user.

The cross-platform version of the pattern: many independent researchers reporting throttling, strikes, demonetisation and account actions on the same subject at once. Ordinary moderation explains part of it, and the page argues about which part.
The case is argued almost entirely on platforms, so platform behaviour becomes evidence: what spread, what stalled, whose accounts were curtailed, and how the event-camera footage was handled.

An Army HADES ISR jet under the callsign AXLE10 made low passes over the corridor that day, and a production drone flew while campus police reportedly engaged none. The crew lists, tasking orders and FAA files that would say what either one recorded have not been released.

Fifty days after the killing, the FBI subpoenaed the registrar behind Archive.today — the one archive that is genuinely hard to delete from. The operator answered by publishing the document itself with a single word: "canary."

The first officer up to the Losee Center roof had a body camera that ran 27 minutes and 35 seconds and stopped as he arrived. Batteries do die; this one reportedly died before the gravel, the screwdriver and the alleged perch were ever filmed.

The ATF reportedly could neither identify nor exclude the recovered jacket fragment as fired from the seized Mauser, so the fragment moved to an FBI lab and the report went under seal. Critics fear the answer arrives through CBLA, a lead-comparison test the FBI abandoned in 2005.

Dispatch broadcast a male in all black with a helmet, a mask and a long gun; an electrician working next door described much the same man; the only rooftop footage shows a prone figure dressed entirely in black. That suspect reportedly stopped appearing in the narrative once federal agents took over.

A prosecution filing reportedly said the state did not intend to offer evidence obtained through forensic extractions of the seized electronics. In the same proceeding an agent testified that a Cellebrite extraction of the roommate's phone was performed, personally reviewed, and used to build the text timeline.

Tail numbers, routes and times are all citizen trackers can see; manifests, cargo logs, visas and security waivers are where the foreign-nexus leads stop. A lead testable only with records nobody will release stays permanently open — which is itself the complaint.

The routing table for the whole cover-up section, grouped by the kind of concealment alleged: scene alteration, kill mechanism, foreign-lead shutdown, digital records, narrative control and institutional secrecy. Start here if you do not yet know which page owns which question.

The allegation that the first framing of September 10 arrived too fast and too uniformly to be organic — bots, paid amplification, and a top-down push on a single label. Genuine virality explains a great deal of it, and the page argues about how much.

A defense motion reportedly places the chief deputy county attorney's teenage daughter about eighty-five feet from Kirk when the shot landed, texting her father in real time. The county attorney reportedly declined a formal screening on the ground that no conflict exists.

Utah S.B. 82 made publicly sharing non-public autopsy photographs and video a class B misdemeanour, effective May 7, 2025 — about four months before September 10. The statute is real and verifiable; everything read into its timing is not.

Attendees who filmed the shooting report their clips were gone, truncated or altered before they got home. No phone in the set has ever been forensically examined, which is exactly what would settle it either way.

Wikipedia's article is the first and often the only page reporters and international readers consult on this case, and its sourcing rules keep the live citizen dispute off it until a mainstream outlet covers it. Good-faith editing can still harden a contested account into apparent consensus.

The most-repeated presence claim is not an eyewitness sighting but a signals-intelligence allegation — twelve Israeli-registered phones, later reported as sixteen. No FOIA release or court exhibit has ever surfaced. That gap is the story.

Two independent threads describe the same reported pattern: the foreign angle closed early. Joe Kent says his probe was shut down; Russell Brand says cabinet sources told him officials were not looking. Neither is a court finding.

Joe Kent is quoted saying multiple people had pre-knowledge and that the FBI shut his investigation down before the leads ran out. He names a foreign nexus specifically. This page collects every lead pointing outside the country.

The leftover threads that fit nowhere else — Mossad supply-chain capability, a reported billion-dollar offer, the Hamptons meeting, the Hezbollah pager analogy. Each is a strand, not a conclusion. Useful for seeing how the argument is actually assembled.

TPUSA owned the chapters, the field staff and the tour logistics — a distribution system aimed at young voters. The reported prize, commentators argue, was the pipeline rather than the man. Read it with the succession timeline beside it.

The argument is capability, not identity — that the tradecraft described exceeds a 22-year-old acting alone. Analogies such as Grim Beeper are used to say could, never did. Read it as a hypothesis being tested.

Two campaigns are alleged to have run at once: amplify the lone gunman, punish foreign-involvement speech. Public-diplomacy budgets are cited as capability context, not as invoices. The censorship section carries the platform-level record.

One widely shared summary put the alleged motive bluntly: keep the campus influence intact, remove the person steering it away. This page treats that as commentary, never a finding. It is the hinge the whole section turns on.

Charlie reportedly went to the White House on June 18, 2025 specifically to argue against regime change in Iran. Weeks later he was dead. The page does not claim Iran was involved — it claims the opposite.

The single most-cited motive in the whole investigation, gathered in one place: the reported Israel friction, the presence claims, the Iran war, and the fight over TPUSA. Every line is attributed. Start here before reading any single motive page.

A daily ranked show is a compounding lever — guests, frames and Israel coverage reaching the same audience every weekday. Proponents point to distribution partners and a reported FARA filing eight days later. Contracts outliving founders proves nothing criminal.

SU-BTT reportedly flew France to Provo on September 4 and left Utah hours before the shooting, with contractors said to have stayed behind. Every line is a flight-log interpretation by commentators, not a finding.

A before-and-after comparison of the same organisation — board, tone, Israel posture, and the speed of the succession. Erika Kirk and TPUSA are living parties and nothing here states wrongdoing. The comparison raises the question; it does not answer it.

Investigators say the takedowns clustered on one angle — Israeli phones, Egyptian planes, donor money — rather than on case chatter generally. Suppression is not proof of guilt, and the page says so plainly. It is the pattern that keeps drawing attention.

The Utah Data Center sits about an hour from UVU, which is why the twelve-phone tip keeps being pointed at it. This page separates what Bumblehive collection could plausibly show from what has actually been released. Nothing has been released.

ODNI is the box directly above NCTC on the org chart, which is why the halt claim lands here. Tulsi Gabbard held the post. Whether the instruction came from this level, or from above it, is the unresolved question.

Roughly a dozen lieutenant colonels reportedly met behind closed doors on September 8 and 9, two days before Utah. The Joint Task Force involved was later reassigned. Attendance lists have never been released.

A routing memo rather than an argument: every U.S. intelligence thread in the case sorted by the question it answers. Who says the inquiry stopped, who sits above NCTC, whose jet was overhead. Start here if the section looks tangled.

As Director of National Intelligence she sat directly above the NCTC review that reportedly stopped. Her public responses, and the cabinet-shutdown claims attributed to Russell Brand, are collected here. All of it is reported, none of it adjudicated.

One open-source account matched a carpet pattern, dark trim, and yellow wall in a publicly posted alibi video to Fort Huachuca interiors. It is a single X account's visual claim, not a forensic match. The page says so before it says anything else.
